title: Warm Spicy Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: A spicy and velvety Venezuelan dish featuring chicken and khus khus, with a double fry method similar to KFC, and sugar free friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
In a blender or food processor, blend the onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the blended mixture to the chicken breast and mix until the chicken is well coated.
Add the khus khus to the chicken mixture and mix until well combined.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut out circles of dough.
Place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Double fry the empanadas by frying them at 350 degrees for 2 minutes, then increasing the heat to 375 degrees and frying for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the empanadas from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
